title: Template-app onboarding — guided walkthrough visuals + README flow diagrams
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Produce a compact, reusable set of onboarding visuals and README flow diagrams for the Template Apps bundle used in quickstart docs and reference apps. These assets will be used by SDK docs, the Template App repo README, and the Console 'Create Template' flow.

Scope: capture annotated screenshots (desktop + mobile), create a linear flow diagram for README (Mermaid + SVG export), and deliver Figma components and export spec. Focus on clarity for first-time users: where to set API key, how to run locally, and how to connect to Redwood Hosted vs Dedicated.

Design constraints and decisions so far: prefer a 3-card hero flow (Install → Configure → Run) rather than the longer 5-step carousel to reduce cognitive load. Use a single device mock (MacBook Pro) for desktop screenshots and a Pixel 6 frame for mobile; provide @2x PNGs and one responsive SVG of the flow diagram. Include localized copy placeholders for ES/FR/DE.
export_spec: Mobile: 375x812 artboard, export PNG @2x, include safe area guides
Flow diagram: export SVG + optimized PNG fallback
Annotations: separate layer in Figma, export as transparent PNG overlay
README_diagram_notes: Master README diagram will be a Mermaid-compatible flow showing: clone repo -> install deps -> set REDWOOD_API_KEY -> run dev -> open sample route
Provide alt text for diagram (summary line + step list) for screen readers
Embed SVG in README using raw.githubusercontent.com link and fall back to PNG for GH pages
tasks: Capture fresh screenshots from template-app v2.1 in Hosted and Dedicated modes
Create annotated overlays for API key modal and console route picker
Design Mermaid flow and export optimized SVG for README
Prepare Figma file with component variants and localization slots
Coordinate with docs engineer to update README embed and image paths
acceptance_criteria: All screenshots in assets folder with filenames matching screenshot_list
README contains inline SVG flow and PNG fallback, verified in GH preview
Figma file shared with Engineering and Docs with commenting enabled
Localization placeholders exist for ES/FR/DE and copy approved by PM
PR with updated README and assets merged: template-apps PR referenced in attachments
